import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Fix the structure - remove bad stubs and add inside class
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("head -76 /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/world/ChunkSystem.ts > /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -n +82 /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/world/ChunkSystem.ts >> /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts")
# Add stubs INSIDE class
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('echo "    // Stub methods for WorldTick compatibility" >> /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('echo "    public getActiveChunks(): any[] {" >> /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('echo "        return Array.from(this.chunks.values()).filter((c: any) => c && c.isActive);" >> /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('echo "    }" >> /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('echo "" >> /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('echo "    public setChunkActive(id: string, active: boolean): void {" >> /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('echo "        const xy = id.split('\\'':'\\'').map(Number);" >> /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('echo "        const chunk = this.getChunk(xy[0], xy[1]);" >> /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('echo "        if (chunk) (chunk as any).isActive = active;" >> /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('echo "    }" >> /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('echo "}" >> /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts')
# Replace
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("mv /tmp/chunksystem_fixed.ts /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/world/ChunkSystem.ts")
print("Fixed")
client.close()
